title: Klusiaaa's Craftable Uncraftable Items
description: This Project adds a bunch of recipes for uncraftable items
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c7f0565ab8ab6237ab15bd825f92d96a4d7713b.png)

⭐ Craftable Uncraftable Items Is
A datapack that adds balanced, survival‑friendly crafting recipes for rare items that normally cannot be crafted in Minecraft.

Designed to feel fair, logical and vanilla‑friendly, making rare items more accessible without breaking game balance.
Perfect for survival worlds, SMP servers, and modded playthroughs.

✔ Features
Crafting recipes for rare, survival‑obtainable items

All recipes use logical, vanilla‑style materials

Fully multiplayer compatible

Works on Minecraft 1.21.9 – 1.21.11

Includes almost all spawn eggs, elytra, totem, horse armor, and more

✈ Elytra

![elytra](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cbbe7219c036c2f63d6899384804c8e025011a0.png)

⛓ Chainmail Armor

![chainmail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a256b95f4817b264266f6f19b9275a1787b4dfd.png)

🍏 Enchanted Golden Apple

![notch apple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09d05a80befa7ae413798855b31bc24513e522c5.png)

📌 Name Tag

![name tag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5eac040a3c635bdae1a9332fd92b42a2e31ec1a.png)
You can also change the Iron Nugget to Copper or Gold.

⬜ Invisible Item Frame

![invisible item frame](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94810553d220b8c47fbad523d0eda00dea993969.png)
Works with both normal and glow item frames.

♾ Totem of Undying

![totem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/920d5519f2714d83fa0bbbcb6d54908e122dccaa.png)

🥚 Spawn Eggs
Almost all spawn eggs are now craftable, using logical materials based on mob drops and behavior.

🐴 Horse Armor

![horse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/120d9af3a92fe50f0e060cd6cd1ada11a8ba980b.png)
Change the Iron to Copper, Gold, or Diamond for different variants.

🔫 Gunpowder

![gunpowder](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40385488a35089abd3919977974e7a4d6a9213e5.png)
Smelt Coal or Charcoal to obtain Gunpowder.
